title: Research: sharp mixed-rank centre-sharing overhead limits
body:
PR1791 prices centre-sharing overhead one rank at a time. This package gives the sharp total added mass over every mixed integer histogram on ranks 1..51, keeping the actual selected two-call-sharing profile, width, stock and native surcharge convention fixed.

| Moment target | Maximum overhead mass | Attaining additions | Next mass |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| Selected bit endpoint | 4,445 | 87 rank-51 + one rank-8 | 4,446 fails |
| Selected complex endpoint + 1e-24 | 4,622 | 90 rank-51 + one rank-32 | 4,623 fails |

A written strict-concavity exchange argument reduces the entire finite-histogram domain to the largest-rank quotient/remainder partition. Separately written integer-root and rational log/exp engines certify both directions at each boundary. The second ceiling exceeds the 4,608 mass removed by sharing: mass alone does not determine the power bill. These are existence ceilings in a pricing relaxation; actual overhead must be priced by its complete histogram.

The package also proves that PR1791's 649-bit-mass threshold is sharp for arbitrary mixtures of **pure removals**, with the count surcharge recomputed. A zero-mass reblocking control shows why that restriction matters. Independent finite-grid arithmetic confirms the stated bit cap and a strictly improved recipe value for the 4,622-mass witness. No physical reblocking, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

Validation: registered Python 3.12.12 replay passes on macOS arm64; separate Python 3.14.6 optimized checks pass. Coverage includes 728 algebraic power fixtures, 2,649 complete small partitions, eleven scientific-receipt corruptions rejected by both engines, both input-pin corruptions, two arithmetic defects with detector-removal sensitivity, missing-receipt rejection, explicit regeneration and optimized read-only relocation. Six test groups, metadata/source pins, selected-record integrity and whitespace pass. Hosted CI is separate.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-sharing-mixed-overhead
```

Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. Predecessor PR1791: `00d05a64898571cf57a14310fbcd3507ca99c5ec`. Source pins and exact rational evidence are in the package. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1516#discussioncomment-18924590); complementary to [batch B round 01's single-rank audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18924424). Chooser nonce and refined independent-moment task are retained in TASK.json.

Credits: rtyu193-rgb/PR1791, PR1708/1748 sharing mechanisms, navinor and Wronskode's pricing/assembly definitions, arkfx's earlier integer-root audit, Douglas Colkitt/PR1012, the selected complex lineage, and PR589/555's bit lineage. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate mathematical specialist; no independent human or formal-kernel review. Apache-2.0.

Remaining: actual common-source caller, compatible operators, routing, restoration, hosting, precision/tape and complete changed invoice/outer admission. The full selected cold replay and all 47 outer inequalities were not independently rerun. Selected frontier and frozen sources are unchanged.
